name: ButtonDoor
brief: A door puzzle: a room with a SpawnLocation, a wall with a closed door in it, and a finish pad behind the wall. A button on the floor in front of the wall opens the door.
contract: Create a SpawnLocation inside script.Parent, on the same side of the wall as the button.
The door is a Part named Door filling the only gap in the wall; the button is a Part named Button on the floor; the finish pad behind the wall is a Part named Goal.
The wall must be too high to jump over and must reach the room's side walls, so the only way to the Goal is through the door.
Touching Button opens the door (make it non-collidable and transparent) and it stays open.
